method.firstTerminalOutputMs: parent perf_counter from PTY fork to first master read; may be a capability query
method.firstFrameMs: native runtime.start epoch minus parent wall start plus first frame.written 1 runtime offset
method.startupDoneMs: same epoch alignment for native startup.done; not a fully-ready guarantee
method.peakRssKiB: max sampled /proc child VmHWM and wait4 ru_maxrss; Darwin bytes normalized to KiB
method.startupMemory: best-effort /proc status and smaps_rollup after observing startup.done; includes recorded observation delay
method.lifetimeMs: fork to wait4; includes native 150 ms post-init dwell and shutdown
method.overhead: native trace file appends, PTY query replies, periodic proc/trace reads, one smaps_rollup snapshot, pre-exec PTY handoff
method.cache: case/loadout fixtures keep their own JITI_FS_CACHE across warmups and measured runs; OS page cache is not flushed
method.order: rotate and reverse case/loadout combinations every round; run processes serially

isolation.providerRequestCounter: not instrumented; no server or prompts are used
